results.title: a client-supplied cf-ipcountry: refused, overwritten or passed through
results.detail: RPC returning request.headers, anon key. No client header -> 200, cf-ipcountry present (true, 2 chars). Same call carrying cf-ipcountry=ZZ -> 200: overwritten by the edge's own value; the value seen equals the no-header call's value: true. For comparison S22a: a client-supplied cf-connecting-ip -> 403. Status fail would mean a caller can choose the country a geo policy reads; the observed country is not recorded.
